mapper.select: SELECT staff_user_id FROM staff_window_scope WHERE window_id = #{windowId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY staff_user_id
SELECT staff_user_id FROM staff_window_scope WHERE outlet_id = #{outletId} AND window_id = 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY staff_user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE staff_window_scope SET deleted = id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE window_id = #{windowId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT o.id outlet_id, o.code outlet_code, o.name outlet_name, w.id window_id, w.code window_code, w.name window_name, i.id item_id, i.code item_code, i.name item_name FROM staff_window_scope s JOIN service_outlet o ON o.id = s.outlet_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'ENABLED' JOIN service_window w ON w.outlet_id = s.outlet_id AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 'ENABLED' AND (s.window_id = 0 OR s.window_id = w.id) LEFT JOIN window_item_rel r ON r.window_id = w.id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN service_item i ON i.id = r.item_id AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE s.staff_user_id = #{staffUserId} AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.id, w.id, i.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff_window_scope WHERE outlet_id = #{outletId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff_window_scope WHERE window_id = #{windowId} AND deleted = 0
